subject: I'd be interesting to see if
author: Cube
body: It'd be interesting to see if the newly-added puzzles (there weren't any in the Japanese demo) and new control scheme (stand-and-shoot only suits horror scenarios) help the game. And hopefully there are some non-bland environments in the final game. They could also do with removing the massive invisible barriers surrounding every object that you can't pick up (including plants).
